rumor_browse_feed.planner_hint: Browse the recommendation feed on your carried phone when you have a social platform activity opportunity.
rumor_browse_feed.grounder_hint: target_id must be the carried phone from inventory. parameters.limit is optional.

rumor_open_post.planner_hint: Open a visible post from the carried phone's fresh feed context.
rumor_open_post.grounder_hint: target_id must be the carried phone. parameters.slot selects the feed item; default is 0.

rumor_comment_post.planner_hint: Comment on a currently visible or open post if your reaction is grounded in the context.
rumor_comment_post.grounder_hint: target_id must be the carried phone. parameters.text is required; parameters.slot is optional.

rumor_repost_post.planner_hint: Repost a currently visible or open post if you decide to amplify it.
rumor_repost_post.grounder_hint: target_id must be the carried phone. parameters.text may contain a repost note; parameters.slot is optional.

rumor_create_post.planner_hint: Create an original post only when recent memories, offline context, or platform content gives you a reason to react.
rumor_create_post.grounder_hint: target_id must be the carried phone. parameters.text is required; parameters.tags is optional.
